summary: Temporary danger area for drone flights near Monks Wood, Sawtry, with a 1.88 nautical mile radius and drones limited to 400 feet above ground level.
text:
TEMPO DANGER AREA (TDA) EGD288A INSTALLED WI 1.88NM RADIUS OF
522410N 0001404W (MONKS WOOD, SAWTRY). BEYOND VISUAL LINE OF SIGHT
(BVLOS) UAS OPS CONTAINED WHOLLY WI THE TDA. MAX HGT 400FT AGL.
EMERG SER ACFT MAY ENTER THE AIRSPACE IN ACCORDANCE WITH LOCAL
DECONFLICTION AGREEMENTS. OPN AND SPECIFIC CAT VISUAL LINE OF
SIGHT (VLOS) UAS OPS ARE PERMITTED WI THE TDA WO PRIOR APPROVAL OR
DECONFLICTION. OTHER NON-STANDARD FLIGHT, FLIGHT RESTRICTION ZONE
OR CONTROLLED AIRSPACE APPROVALS MUST BE OBTAINED. OPR ARE REMINDED
OF THEIR RESPONSIBILITY UNDER CAP 722 5.2.2.3 REGARDING OPR IN CLOSE
PROXIMITY TO AN EMERG RESPONSE EFFORT. FOR CREWED ACCESS 
01223 823551 OR PORTAL.AIRSENTRY.UK. FOR INFO AROPS(AT)CAA.CO.UK.
AR-2026-6226/05.
